notes.title: Demo Updated and Thank You!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We've been working hard on Card Clash Chronicles behind the scenes and now we've had a chance to look over the feedback we received from Next Fest, we wanted to make a little post to thank you all for trying our game!

We also pushed a fix for a couple of bugs and errors in the demo that were pointed out to us.

Fixes:

Fixed Card Collector Achievement not activating.
Fixed Crash that could happen when viewing messages in the phone.
Fixed Ricky disappearing after he entered the Café.

There is a lot more coming and we will be back with some news, devlogs and more very soon!

We're really looking forward to eventually releasing the full game to you all.

Kind regards,

The ApocVerse Team.

notes.title: Demo Fixes and Tweaks
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Thank you so much for trying out the demo for Card Clash Chronicles and for the feedback we've received so far.

We've pushed an update with some additions, fixes and changes.

Changelog:

- Added a tooltip to the deck screen showing the buttons to remove cards from the deck
- Added more deck variety to opponents
- Added two more cards
- Fixed only being able to buy one booster pack
- Fixed music stopping after a duel
- Tweaks to make the way booster packs display a bit better
- Moved the exit button for the deck editor to prevent it being obscured by cards

Thanks again for playing and we can't wait to release the full game to you all!

Kind regards,

ApocVerse

notes.title: The Demo is Now Released!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we're announcing the release of the demo for Card Clash Chronicles!

We were going to wait until next fest, but we couldn't wait to get the demo in your hands!

This bite sized look into the game will show you what to expect when the full game releases within the next few months.

Features:


 Duel Your Way Through the Back Alley
 Collect 8 Different Cards
 Defeat All Opponents to Finish the Demo!
 The full game will contain many more cards (over 100), locations and a fun story to go with it too!


Please Enjoy!

Kind regards,

ApocVerse
